name: Elemental Ward
body:
School abjuration; Level druid 4, magus 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range 60 ft.

Area 60-ft.-radius emanation centered on you

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

This spell forces elementals to leave the area. Any elemental that fails their Will save must leave and not re-enter the emanation.
